title: Digital Tyre Inflator for IOCL - AIROJET 1000 LCV P
description: Pedestal mounted digital tyre inflator for IOCL fuel stations with 5 in 1 switch box.
subtitle: Pedestal - Normal (IOCL)
fullDescription: Pedestal mounted digital tyre inflator for fuel stations. Features two digital readouts, LCD display with LED backlight, 5 in 1 switch box with fuse protection and indicator, and can be used for vehicle tyre ranging from two wheeler, car, SUV and mini truck.
features: Two digital readouts one for set pressure and other for tyre pressure
LCD display with LED back light to provide good visibility
Display remain at same set pressure value even after power on-off cycle
Audible and visual end of the cycle signal indicators
LED indication for the status of operation
Soft touch and durable membrane keys suitable for outdoor
Separate keys for set pressure increment and decrement
Flat key for empty or puncture tyre
25/35 key for easy front and back tyre pressure setting
Reset key to exit out of operation at any time
5 in 1 switch box with fuse protection and indicator
Can use for vehicle tyre ranging from two wheeler, car, SUV and mini truck

specifications.inputAirHose: 6mm x 2mtrs Black braider Hose with suitable fittings
specifications.inputFilter: 1/4 x 5 micron air filter with suitable fittings
specifications.outputAirHose: PVC braided hose suitable for 14K g/cm2 pressure with round head foot connector
specifications.keypad: Membrane Keypad suitable for outdoor application
specifications.display: 4 Digit 7 Segment LCD with Automatic LED backlight ON & OFF
specifications.dimensions: 415 x 210 x 1390 mm (pedestal), 425 x 250 x 1420 mm (Packing)

applications: Fuel Station (for IOCL, BPCL, HPCL, ESSAR, RELIANCE and other leading companies)
